svg.title: iOS · Shape-mation · Find shapes · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/FindShapesView.swift (plan card) over ShapeFinder.candidates — 2026-09-11, code first, mirrored from the running app (iPhone 16 Pro simulator, LL_SHAPEMATION=find). Pushed inside the Shape-mation sheet's own NavigationStack from the Find shapes door (shapemation.portrait.svg): back "Shape-mation", large title "Find shapes". One card (llCard 18, 16-pt padding, 12-pt spacing): the plan title "3 projects to analyse" (17 semibold; "Every project has been checked." when nothing is left), the explanation at 14 secondary — one picture per project, the rendered blend where there is one, else the middle frame, searched for circles, ovals, squares and rectangles; kept with the project; analysed again only when the detector has improved, kept or drawn shapes stay — six lines as wrapped on the 402-pt device (2026-09-12: detector version 2 re-offers version-1 registers, so the paragraph grew a line, the tertiary line gained 'N from an older detector' and the button moved down 16.8 pt); the tertiary 12-pt line "10 already analysed · 4 from an older detector · 0 video shoots left out" (shown when either count is non-zero); and the full-width borderedProminent button "Find shapes" (16 semibold on LL.accent, 57 pt tall, ~16-pt continuous corners — not a capsule), absent when there is nothing to analyse. Tapping it starts ShapeFinder.run: the card becomes the progress card — viewfinder.circle, "Analysing n of N" (15 semibold), a Stop button, an accent ProgressView and the current project's title on one line — then the summary (shapemation.find.done.portrait.svg). The progress state was not captured: three projects analyse in well under a second, so the reference run had finished before the screenshot; no hook freezes it. Leaving the screen mid-run cancels. Measured geometry: the sheet's top edge sits at y 72 on the 16 Pro (69 on the 393-pt canvas device); the paragraph's first line is 335 pt wide on the 16 Pro's 338-pt inner width and re-wraps ("where" drops) on a 393-pt device.

g.text: One picture per project — the rendered blend where
there is one, else the middle frame — is searched
for circles, ovals, squares and rectangles. Results
are kept with the project; a project is analysed
again only when the detector has improved, and
shapes you kept or drew stay.
10 already analysed · 4 from an older detector · 0 video shoots left out
